reviews.text:
We've known Vet for Life for a long time, but I'd like to dedicate this review especially to Dr. Stefano Pinto, who cared for our Diana, knows Tommaso, and now cares for our Sofia.

Those who love their animals know how important it is to find a veterinarian capable of supporting you even in the most difficult moments. With Diana, we experienced immense pain. Now Sofia is facing a situation that brings us back to that experience, and knowing we can count on Dr. Pinto means a lot to us.

Today we returned for a checkup: Sofia is stable and hasn't had any hemorrhages. Dr. Pinto continues to care for her with care, sensitivity, and humanity. He listens to us, explains what's happening, and makes us feel supported in what is anything but easy for us.

We also know and appreciate the people who work at Vet for Life, but I want to extend a special thank you to Dr. Pinto. He is a great professional and, above all, a great gentleman. Sofia is in good hands. ❤️

✍️ Pino Carleo

I would like to thank all the staff at the Vet for Life clinic. In addition to their high level of professionalism, there is a widespread sense of emotional involvement both towards the animals and their families. I would especially like to thank Dr. Pinto for his expertise and professionalism. A heartfelt thank you once again from ❤️. Salvio
I've been taking my dog ​​here for years, and they've saved him on more than one occasion. Dr. Pinto is very professional, knowledgeable, helpful, and above all, human.

I am deeply disappointed with the service I received from this vet. After five ultrasounds performed by Dr. Stefano, my dog's tumor was not found. After the symptoms worsened and our persistence, the diagnosis was finally made, but because the tumor had grown so large and had already caused extensive damage, even a child would have noticed! We had to take the dog to an oncologist because Vet for Life didn't even perform the biopsy correctly, taking an unsuitable sample. Furthermore, Dr. Stefano, having realized his mistake, didn't even have the courage to break the news to us in person, after examining my dog ​​at least six times in two months. After the biopsy, he left and had a doctor give us the news, among other things, giving us the name of a random tumor. Thanks to the three oncology visits we had after them and a CORRECTLY performed biopsy, they told us the name of the tumor, which was completely different from the one they had just given us, without having anything to hand.

It's hard to accept that, despite numerous tests, such a serious condition wasn't recognized earlier. I'm left with a tremendous sense of sadness and the conviction that I would have liked to have received greater attention, in-depth analysis, and clarity during the diagnostic process.

I'm writing this review because I believe it's important for anyone who entrusts their pet's health to a professional to know what happened in my case. The loss of my dog ​​was devastating, and I'm sure a more timely diagnosis could have changed things.
In the end, my dog ​​didn't make it, and especially Dr. Stefano, if I can call him a doctor, will remember my Spritz, which he will carry on his conscience with peace of mind!

Fortunately, my Argo hasn't had any health problems in 10 years... only once, on Easter Sunday in 2000, did he risk his life... in the entire Campania region, no one accepted my dog ​​because it was Easter... only they, with great professionalism, love, and honesty, accepted Argo, calling the surgeon at the clinic... I recommend it. A special thank you for saving Argo... thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Impeccable expertise and ethics. A cutting-edge clinic located in the heart of Naples that treats our pets with the true heart of Naples. Extraordinary, empathetic, and highly trained doctors. We couldn't ask for more for the health of our pets. A huge thank you from me and Nikolina!

I had to urgently hospitalize my elderly beagle, Kevin, due to acute hemorrhagic viral gastroenteritis. He was in critical condition. Thanks to the prompt intervention of the clinic staff, he was saved, and after four days of hospitalization, he was able to return home and is now doing well again. I would like to sincerely thank all the clinic staff who cared for my dog, demonstrating great professionalism and immense affection.

I learned about the clinic through a volunteer. My puppy, Thor, has been treated there for over a month. Dr. Autiero and her team are doing everything they can to save him, giving him so much love and attention. I thank them again so much, hoping Thor finds a solution for his life. ♥️

Rare professionals who work with all their heart.
They don't just care for our pet, they demonstrate extraordinary sensitivity and humanity. Prompt, calm, and highly competent doctors. Infinite thanks to all the staff.
The clinic was disorganized, confusing, and lacked professionalism. My worst experience.

I have my dog ​​Danny, a 10-year-old mixed breed. We recently discovered he has diabetes. I brought him in on April 22nd. He was suffering from acetosis and a glycemic crisis. We didn't know if he would survive the night. Fortunately, thanks to the care and attention of all the staff, after 10 days of hospitalization he was fine. Unfortunately, other problems have arisen and we are still undergoing treatment. A special thanks to Dr. Sara, Dr. Antonella, and Dr. Caterina, who take care of him, but also to all the staff who work at the clinic. They give me the right instructions to be able to treat him at home. They are kind and animal-loving people.

There are no words to describe their skill and helpfulness.
They saved my Mirtilla, a 2-month-old puppy who tested positive for parvovirus. They didn't just treat her, they cared for her, treating her like a princess. I will be eternally grateful.
Simply thank you for existing.
Same situation in a much more expensive place, paying less than half the price and with the option of assistance. Unfortunately, a very negative experience. Exploiters.

We've had a cat treated by them for almost five years because he has a series of chronic conditions that flare up from time to time. We've always found everyone to be professional and helpful; they've saved our cat several times and have always given us the right direction. We highly recommend them.

I took my 5-year-old cat to the emergency room yesterday, Easter, for vomiting and anorexia after several days of hematuria.

The tests showed:
• White blood cell count 36,000
• pH 7.23 with low bicarbonate
• Lactate 6

Despite these parameters, the cat was discharged home with oral antibiotic therapy, without hospitalization or intravenous fluid therapy, with instructions to bring her back the next day if she didn't drink.

A few hours after returning home, her condition rapidly deteriorated, with tachypnea and severe clinical deterioration. She was taken to another emergency room, where, unfortunately, nothing could be done; she went into cardiac arrest and died.

I believe the clinical situation was already serious and warranted more intensive management and close monitoring.

I am sharing my experience so that others may be aware of how quickly a seemingly mild situation can escalate into an emergency, and that such situations deserve the MAXIMUM ATTENTION.

I brought my almost 15-year-old dog with a 6.5-degree pyometric tumor in her uterus. She has lung problems. The situation is tragic... I received assistance. Both she and I. Competence, professionalism, and humanity. The surgeon spoke clearly to me: she might not make it. His hand is... that of God, even though she ended up in intensive care. Now she is in excellent health. I want to congratulate the entire staff. For their humanity. For their kindness and professionalism, thank you, thank you.

Thank you to the Vet For Life clinic, which literally saved my dog. Thank you to Doctors Stefano, Imma, and Sara, who treated and saved my Sophie with professionalism and empathy. Thank you to all the tireless and incredibly professional staff.
Thank you to Max, a wonderful and generous dog, who with his blood gave my puppy hope again.
Thank you to Sophie, who fought to keep me from losing her love.
Excellent. I always recommend them to anyone who has problems with their dog. They're all really good. I go there even if I'm far away because I trust them.
They were great, super kind.
Thank you with all my heart
I want to share my experience. The clinic is well-organized and the doctors are excellent. The staff is very kind and caring. A special thanks to Dr. Sara for taking such loving care of my Leo.

Excellent medical staff, friendly and helpful.
I highly recommend them.
thank you with all my heart

Zero humanity, zero professionalism.
I called for an emergency surgery on my pet, and since he's 16 and has a small heart murmur, they refused to admit me because they "don't feel like it."
Of course, I'm free, but I'm expressing my opinion. It's the same thing as asking for surgery on an elderly person and the hospital tells you... "I don't feel like it," or rather, he might even die. Speechless, also because a clinic has a moral as well as personal duty to save animals, and all this without even seeing him... over the phone.
Long live the veterinarians who dedicate their lives to serving animals with courage and love.

Our dog Joey had been eating two different kinds of dog food, a grocery store brand, Deco and was getting sick so we switched him to a much better brand, Royal Canin but he was still vomiting after three days.  So we took him to Vet for life.  We are extremely happy we took him there!  The veterinarian assistant spoke English and was very helpful with the translations.  The doctor was very caring and checked out Joey thoroughly.  She gave him an injection for his digestive system and gave us medications for him and told us to only feed him the Royal Canin (we had also been giving him some pizza crust🙃).  He is doing much better!  We are so thankful to Vet For Life!  Grazie mille!
They are wonderful

Today I visited the clinic for the third time for my Ercole. I would like to especially thank Dr. Paolo Zarelli for his professionalism and dedication in finding the best treatment for this problem. Thanks again.

It's the only clinic where I can take my pets (two cats and one dog) without any worries. They're always available, competent, and not at all greedy. When my dog ​​was hospitalized for only two days, they even offered me the chance to visit him, given my emotional state. I can only thank them. It's a shame they're not open on holidays and at night.

We were very lucky to choose this clinic. The staff is professional, very courteous, and helpful. Dr. Paolo Zarelli literally saved little Nami, who came to him in desperate conditions, and today we can finally say that she is doing well! We owe him all our gratitude and recommend him to everyone!!!
Monica Picardi

We just wanted to say a special thank you to Dr. Pinto for taking care of Natalie until the end, an impeccable doctor who accompanied our little girl through every stage of her illness, thanks also to Dr. Sara. Natalie was a very wary dog, but she was calm with them, this is a sign of a good doctor.

You are wonderful people...you are our angels...my puppy Leo and I are grateful for every time we bother you with every trivial thing, you are always ready to welcome us with a smile and to reassure us...you are unique

I brought my cat Ely to them with an intestinal problem, which they resolved brilliantly with great professionalism and patience. Thanks to Dr. Zarelli and his team for their clarity and transparency in explaining the medical issue and the costs involved. Thank you also for the kindness you showed Ely, who isn't exactly a sweetheart with strangers...

INCOMPETENT. FILTERED CLINIC.
DOCTOR Z. (THE HEALTH DIRECTOR) WHO ATTACKS EVERYONE EVEN IF THEY ASK A SIMPLE QUESTION, RUDE, OFFENSIVE, LACKING PATIENCE AND PROFESSIONALISM.
BUT I'LL TELL YOU...MY CAT LILOU, WHO WAS MY THERAPY PET, THE LOVE OF MY LIFE, WAS HOSPITALIZED ON MAY 19, 2025...AFTER A NIGHT'S HOSPITALITY, AND 5 DAYS OF ALL KINDS OF TESTS, ULTRASOUND, ALL KINDS OF BLOOD TESTS (even unnecessary tests), FOUR OF THEM WERE AWARE THAT IT WAS FIP!
THEY MADE ME DO TESTS THAT HAD NOTHING TO DO WITHOUT ANYTHING, BY TRYING TO SEND ME AWAY WITHOUT A DIAGNOSIS, AND ABOVE ALL THAT "DOCTOR" ANTONELLA, SHE CALLED ME SAYING THAT MY CAT WOULD NOT LET THEM TOUCH IT AND TO COME AND LEND A HAND. I FOUND HER IN A POND OF PEE, AND WITH HER RIGHT HIND PAW COMPLETELY OUT OF USE, SHE SAID NOTHING HAD HAPPENED. I EVEN ASKED HER IF BY ANY CHANCE SHE HAD FALLEN OR SOMETHING, SHE DENIED IT. I LEFT AWAY, PAID €530, WITHOUT ANY RESPONSE, AND WITH THE CAT DISABLED. A FIP TEST WOULD HAVE JUST BEEN ONE. LUCKILY I WENT ELSEWHERE, WHERE THEY CONFIRMED THAT MY RIGHT HIND LEG HAD A SWOLLEN EDEMA FROM TRAUMA AND WAS FULL OF FLUID. ..IT WAS ANTONELLA WITH AN INTERN WITH A LITTLE ANGEL TATTOO ON HER NECK. WHO KNOWS WHAT THEY DID HER BY DENYING IT TOO... SHE WENT OUT ON THREE LEGS WORSE THAN BEFORE, AND IF FIP HAD BEEN DIAGNOSED IMMEDIATELY I WOULD HAVE HAD A WAY TO FIND THE GS DRUG, BUT MY CAT IS GONE, IT WAS TOO LATE, I HAD TO PUT HER TO SLEEP... AND SHE SPENT HER LAST DAYS IN EXTRA SUFFERING BECAUSE WHO KNOWS WHAT HAPPENED TO HER DOWNSTAIRS FOR HER TO HAVE TO RETURN HER TO ME FULL OF PEE
AND ON THREE LEGS. THE ONE WITH THE GLASSES, SHORT AND CURLY HAIR (ANTONELLA) LIED TO ME, YET I TRUSTED HER, I ASKED HER IF SOMETHING HAD HAPPENED, SHE DENIED... LILU' DIED ON MAY 31ST. EVERY DAY WOULD HAVE BEEN VITAL TO SAVE HER, AND DON'T SAY I'M NOT ON THE PC LIKE YOU ALWAYS DO WITH EVERY NEGATIVE REVIEW TO PROTECT YOURSELF.... BECAUSE EVERYTHING IS THERE IN THE NAME OF FIRMAMENTO OR FERRANTINO. YOU SHOULD BE REPORTED, YOU SHOULD JUST CLOSE IT.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the Vet for Life clinic, and in particular to Dr. Paolo Zarelli and Dr. Alessandro Esposito, for the extraordinary professionalism, expertise, and compassion they demonstrated in treating our poodle, Leo, following a compound fracture of the radius and ulna of his front leg.
From the very first moment, we felt welcomed and supported. The doctors combined clarity and technical expertise, explaining the diagnosis and the surgical procedures in a precise and reassuring manner.
The operation was conducted excellently.
Following the surgery, the post-operative protocol was impeccable: pain management with targeted analgesics, antibiotics, constant monitoring, and careful medication.
Throughout every phase, Dr. Zarelli and the other doctors at Vet for Life demonstrated care, patience, and extraordinary empathy.
Thank you so much for accompanying our little one on this delicate journey.

Viviana M.

A SHAME!!! I found a small bird (a swift) on the ground, in the middle of the street, in the scorching heat. The animal couldn't fly, but the care protocol is very simple: leave it alone in a cardboard box, and in a few hours it will return to normal temperature and be able to fly. I went desperately to the vet because I had a train to Rome in 30 minutes and was just looking for help. The woman was very rude to me, telling me they didn't care for birds. I asked her for a phone number to call, but she didn't help either. I was crying a lot, distressed because I didn't know what to do with the animal. The woman said, "Calm down, breathe, there's nothing wrong," and closed the door in my face. You have so little shame. Not only are you not helping a defenseless animal (whose treatment, by the way, was very simple and quick), but you're also leaving a girl having an anxiety attack at the door with suitcases, backpacks, and a pet that can't fly. These are not animal vets, they're vets for money. Heartless people!
Very good especially Dr. Pinto

Vetforlife is a large family, whose expertise and professionalism I've known all my life. In recent years, in addition to the cats, I've entrusted them with my aunt's most precious possession, sweet dog Chanel. She fought so hard, receiving comprehensive care from puppy to adult, saved from pyometra, from acute gastroenteritis that was nearly killing her, from kidney cancer, from diabetes. Chanel received every treatment possible, fighting as long as she could to be with her owner. She's no longer with us, but thanks to the care and the great love that surrounded her, she lived a long life. Imma, Paolo, Stefano, Antonella... a heartfelt thank you for the love you give beyond the care, the added value for our puppies and for us owners.
thank you with all my heart

Exactly two weeks ago, my 6-year-old puppy was rushed to the hospital and underwent emergency surgery for pyometra. The surgery was a complete success, thanks to Dr. Paolo Zarelli and the entire staff. They were loving, compassionate, and meticulous. Thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you!
Thank you with all my heart
Never go to these I don't know what to describe one evening my dog ​​had injured a paw and needed stitches. It was absurd that before opening I wondered if I had money but we realize 😡😡😡 …
thank you with all my heart
The team is always available and efficient, even at night in emergencies. Thank you for your professionalism and patience, from booking appointments to choosing treatments.
Our dog was diagnosed with osteoarthritis, and since we started treatment she seems to have recovered. Thank you ♥️
I brought my dog ​​who was ill some time ago, and he was treated with competence and above all love
I brought my Aron for sepsis. He was hospitalized for several days and they saved him. It's nothing compared to human intensive care. Thank you ♥️
Empathetic and professional staff, who helped me better manage my elderly dog's joint pain. With a tailored therapy, he's finally feeling better. A super positive experience.

I went to the facility over the weekend for an emergency with my toy poodle. The doctors and nurses were very professional and empathetic. They treated my Goji as if he were their own. This will definitely be my new go-to facility.

Terrible experience. They're only good at issuing invoices for €135 for a poorly applied dressing on an ear ulcer! They don't keep appointments, are rude, and the cleanliness of the office is a very personalized concept! I hope you need doctors who treat you like you treat animals!

I have known this clinic for 12 years, having 2 dogs, they have a wonderful team, especially Dr. Immacolata Autiero, always available, professional, always attentive to any eventuality or need of the patients, I have always recommended the VET FOR LIFE clinic to anyone who asked me because they are a fantastic team!!!
I found great professionalism, but also empathy from all the staff. My cat didn't make it, but I didn't feel alone. I thank them all.

Our experience was excellent. We entrusted ourselves to Dr. Paolo Zarelli, who definitely saved the life of our dog, who had two bladder stones and was dying. It's a clinic with doctors who are all excellent, but above all, humane. Dr. Paolo Zarelli is a very professional and caring person. We were overjoyed that our dog was back home, which is the greatest joy for us. We also met Dr. Stefano, who explained everything to us with kindness and gentleness before the surgery.
I absolutely recommend this clinic; in my opinion, it's the best in Naples so far. ❤️
Doctors with a rare level of professionalism! There are no words to describe their love for animals. I finally know my dog ​​is in good hands. Highly recommended!
incompetent and zero hygiene

We found fantastic, competent, professional, and kind doctors at this clinic.
Thank you for everything you've done.
Thank you with all my heart
Dear Mr. D'Alessandro, you are not listed in our management system. You must have made a mistake in your review. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at 081446155.

A clinic of excellence: we have decades of experience, always cared for by everyone with care and professionalism, but also with a lot of love from Dr. Imma Autiero. Our beagle Sam suddenly began to feel ill; but, thanks to the professionalism of the staff (Drs. Domenico and Imma), they diagnosed a very rare parathyroid tumor. Promptly operated on by Prof. Scimonetti, our dear Sam was saved. We were cared for excellently by all the staff: the administration, nurses, and doctors, with kindness and understanding. Thank you so much for everything.
Just to call and ask for information for a hypothetical procedure, blunt and acidic in refusing, unwilling to listen, let's imagine bringing my puppy...
